# FallForge

> The AI concierge installer for FallHub. Auto-detects a small business's vertical from its website, harvests the online footprint into a grounding kernel, packages a FallHub deployment with recommended modules, pre-configures the LLM router across five cost/quality blends, and hands the buyer a working AI-first operating system. Runs locally in the browser (sovereign) or via a hosted Cloudflare Worker (faster). Published by AI-Native Solutions. MIT. ◊·κ=1.

## What it is

FallForge turns "install your business OS" from a technical exercise into a 20-minute AI-driven concierge. The buyer answers three questions (business name, URL, vertical override) and watches five phases execute:

1. Discover — fetch website + signal pages · extract text, links, socials
2. Kernel distil — LLM populates the vertical's kernel.json schema
3. Wire — assemble ZIP with kernel + BOM + install guide + module list · optional GitHub push
4. Calibrate — autopilot tuning on the deployed instance
5. Handoff — final report + live URLs

## Supported verticals (auto-detected)

- Hospitality (holiday rental, glamping, B&B, boutique hotel)
- Trades (plumber, electrician, decorator, gas engineer)
- Ad firm (creative agency, brand studio, freelance strategy)
- Accounting practice (bookkeeper, VAT, self-assessment)
- Barbershop chain (multi-location grooming, extensible to gyms/cafés/salons)

## Router blends baked into every install

- Full Frontier — Claude Opus 4.8 across all phases (£80–£300/mo)
- 80/20 default — Claude reasoning + Groq Llama bulk (£20–£60/mo)
- 50/50 — Balanced (£8–£25/mo)
- Full Open — Groq Llama 3.3 70B (£4–£12/mo)
- Local only — WebLLM Llama 3.1 8B in browser (£0/mo)

## Install modes

- Local (£0) — runs entirely in browser · BYOK · sovereign
- Hosted (£29 one-off) — Cloudflare Worker for CORS-free fetching + deeper crawls
- Pro concierge (£199 one-off) — human review of the FallForge output + calibration
